cross_patient.interval: estimands.cluster_bootstrap, reps and seed from statistics.bootstrap

unit_over_seeds_note: H4 declares no unit over seeds. Taken as the mean over seeds by the argument H5.unit_rationale makes for the identical hole -- 'no ARM's skill' is the statement's own noun, and a per-seed maximum takes five draws at the threshold instead of one. Per-seed values are reported regardless and the verdict runner recomputes the aggregate from them.
